Overview of Program and Project Management Openings in Des Moines

A recent listing of professional opportunities highlights numerous program and project management roles available across the Des Moines, Iowa metropolitan area. The available positions span multiple industries, including construction, information technology, financial services, engineering, and public administration.

Prominent regional and national employers have recently posted openings for management and leadership personnel. Because these listings are gathered from professional employment platforms, applicants can find a diverse array of specialization levels ranging from project managers to directors.

Featured Employers and Roles

The compiled vacancy data details specific roles associated with respective organizations in and around Des Moines:

  • Principal Financial Group: Project Manager IV and Business Support & Execution, Assistant Director.
  • PwC: SAP Program Manager- Director and SAP Program Manager- Manager.
  • JE Dunn Construction: Project Director, Power Market and Traveling Project Director- Aviation.
  • HDR: Senior Project Manager (Water) and Sr. Industrial Wastewater Project Manager.
  • Pearson: Advanced Specialist, Project Management.
  • Concentrix & AT&T / Forged Fiber: Senior IT Project Manager – Utility Technology Programs and Network Implementation Program Manager.
  • iCapital: Client Delivery - Assistant Vice President and Project Manager - Associate.
  • EY: SAP - Delivery Excellence - Delivery Lead - Senior Manager and FSO - Insurance Life & Group Transformation Manager.
  • Terracon & The Weitz Company: Senior Project Manager roles in Construction Materials Testing, Aviation Construction, and Data Center Construction.
  • State of Iowa - Executive Branch: Education Program Consultant (Charter School Program Co-Director) and Transformation Analyst.
